title: Power, Sex, Suicide: Mitochondria and the Meaning of Life
note: Mitochondrial energetics connects cell complexity, reproduction and aging. Explanatory biological synthesis, not health advice or technical training. Distinct physiological mechanisms support density; reconstructions of ancient evolution remain less certain than present biochemistry. Broad cross-period subject; no fixed endpoint or predominant disease focus.

Connects energy, oxygen, life and planetary feedback across successive transitions. Separate oxygenation and complexity cases add constraints. Earth-system and environmental change predominate, so T11 applies; evolutionary-scale account spanning the present has no single historical endpoint. Gaia and future-transition interpretations are hypotheses, not established causal laws; evidence confidence low.

Comparative genomics supplies an explanatory synthesis of drift, constraints, gene transfer and evolutionary complexity. Main purpose is argument and mechanisms rather than specialist procedure training. Technical background sections do not alone establish H3. Cosmological origin-of-life speculation earns less evidential credit than comparative-genomic results; no high-confidence V9 finding established. First publication 2011 despite 2012 copyright.

Ocean worlds connect chemistry, planetary energy sources, habitability and mission design. Search strategy and measurement constraints transfer better than speculation about life. Scientific explanation for general readers, not primarily precollege despite a young-adult award nomination. Multiple environments add learning; no ecology-policy or disease focus.

Competing geological causes of successive extinctions connect volcanism, supercontinent geography and environmental feedback. Distinct crises test mechanisms. Environmental change central; endpoint approximately 180 million years ago gives capped H13. Scientific history, not a textbook or unsupported automatic catastrophe veto.

History of climate discovery links instruments, models, institutions and convergence of evidence. Changing hypotheses add distinct lessons about uncertainty and scientific organization. Environmental topic warrants T11; original narrative culminates in 2001 consensus. Original 2003 publication retained despite later updates.

Maternal biology and psychology are explained through research and reported experience. Publisher description does not establish that child-raising advice is the main purpose; V7 is therefore not imposed just from the topic. Mechanisms have limited transfer to the user's domains. Multiple findings add learning, while personal parenting anecdotes lower expected density. No predominant disease or named rule-12 subject.

Accessible explanation of viral function, immunity and discovery; the publisher explicitly addresses lay readers, not technical proficiency. Distinct viral forms and immune mechanisms add learning. Infectious disease predominates, T11 applies. No treatment program or unsupported V7 decision.

Explains hormonal mechanisms through animal and human findings and social interpretation. Empirical hormone effects warrant more confidence than broad behavioral extrapolation. Not health advice, partisan mobilization or an ideological veto merely from controversy. Comparative cases add learning; domain fit is weak. No dominant rule-11 or rule-12 topic established.

Molecular explanations connect smell across natural materials, food and human environments. Explanatory chemistry and history provide value without technical training; neither recipes nor professional procedures are the main nominated purpose. Many distinct compounds and settings can justify length; encyclopedic organization may reduce cumulative narrative. No nutrition-advice veto.

title: The Origins of Genome Architecture
note: Specialist genomics textbook, explicitly characterized as such by evolutionary biologist Axel Meyer; builds population-genetic and quantitative evolutionary proficiency. Excluded before scoring, irrespective of intellectual standing or bibliography size.

Explains foraging, cooperation, mating and conflict through comparative bird behavior. Not primarily bird-identification reference or specialist training. Different behavioral constraints add learning, but transfer to requested industrial and strategic domains is indirect. Natural history alone is not automatically an environmental-issues deduction.

Conditional philosophy asks what human purpose remains after successful superintelligence and post-scarcity. Main nonfiction argument is not converted into fiction by illustrative narratives, nor into V7 by discussion of meaning. Assumed technological success is a stated thought experiment, not an empirically demonstrated forecast. Distinctions can transfer, but extended speculative treatment lowers confidence and density. Philosophy central, T12 applies.

Research interviews and psychological interpretation examine multiple motives for sexual behavior. Explanatory rather than a sex or health instruction program, so no V7 inferred. Reports of motives are stronger evidence than evolutionary causal interpretations. Cases add distinctions, but anecdotal accumulation may reduce density. Weak topic fit is retained in a low score, not an exclusion.

Neuroscience and personal experience explain drug action, adaptation and addiction. Main purpose is explanatory science and memoir, not a recovery instruction plan, so V7 is not established. Distinct drug mechanisms add learning; personal narrative takes some space. Addiction/disease predominates, T11 applies.

Evolutionary medicine distinguishes useful defensive responses from dysregulated mental illness and tradeoffs. Main purpose is an explanatory psychiatric framework, not an individual treatment plan. The smoke-detector distinction transfers; evolutionary reconstructions remain less secure than clinical observations. Different symptoms add constraints, but overarching explanations are not fully audited. Disease central, T11 applies.

Clinical cases analyze infidelity, desire and changing expectations of marriage. The inspected author description establishes inquiry and case interpretation, not a dominant step-by-step life-support program; V7 is not established solely because the author is a therapist. Selected clinical cases limit general causal inference; different conflicts add distinctions but have little direct domain fit. No reader/Amazon count is taken from the author's unverified review aggregate.

Participant observation traces status exchange, gendered labor and conspicuous consumption in global elite nightlife. Ethnographic mechanisms transfer beyond the personalities, so V3 is not established. Different sites illuminate exchange constraints. Social power is central, T12 applies; international fieldwork does not warrant a single-nation deduction.

Signaling and trust under secrecy explain criminal communication and costly displays. Analytical social science, not operational instruction. Contrasting signals and constraints supply transferable strategic lessons. Criminal communication is not automatically central war, political intelligence or finance; T12 zero. Cases span settings rather than a closed historical period.

title: Status and Culture
author: W. David Marx
note: Status competition links taste, identity, fashion and cultural change. Explanatory synthesis, not a success manual. Comparative examples can add mechanisms, though the reach of the status framework is not independently established. Cultural power central, T12 applies. Cross-period rather than one historical interval.

title: Blank Space: A Cultural History of the Twenty-First Century
author: W. David Marx
note: Commercial incentives, platforms and risk aversion are proposed as causes of cultural repetition. Media and culture central, T12 applies. The stagnation diagnosis is contested in principle but no high-confidence specialist-foundation veto is established by this evidence. Different industries add comparisons; contemporary examples and broad interpretive claims reduce durability and confidence. Explicit twenty-first-century period ends at 2025 publication.

History of Boas and his students links fieldwork, institutions and revisions of racial and cultural categories. Science history and transferable evidential lessons prevent a V3 veto; not ideological mobilization merely because its conclusions challenge racial categories. Distinct research cases add learning. US-centered racial anthropology warrants T11. Approximate central early/mid-twentieth-century endpoint 1950, low confidence.

title: Coup d’État: A Practical Handbook
note: The nominated work presents full planning and execution procedures for a coup, from recruitment through post-coup announcements. Its analytic context does not override the technical/procedural training exclusion. No score or ideological veto assigned.

Interviews and a 471-attempt dataset test coordination-game explanations of coups. This is causal research, not a procedural handbook; analytical discussion of domination is not advocacy. Rank-dependent mechanisms and comparisons add learning. Military/political power central, T12 applies. Dataset and central cases span 1950–2000; original 2014 work, later paperback date does not reset age.
